# MultiContactForm

> Self-hosted, multilingual contact form shared by several websites: one form, one backend, one anti-spam system, one mail pipeline. Pick the project and the reason, write the message, and it reaches the site owner by email.

## This site

- [Contact form](./): the project and reason can be preselected with `#project:reason` (e.g. `./#webtools:feedback`); languages by path (`it/`, `en/`, `es/`, `fr/`, `de/`)
- [Privacy & cookie notice](privacy.php): what is collected, why, for how long, and your rights

Sending needs JavaScript: the anti-spam proof-of-work runs in the browser.

## Key facts

- PHP 8.1+, no database, no Composer, no npm, no CDN, no build step; runs on shared hosting
- Mail through SMTP or the Brevo HTTP API (for hosts that block mail ports); optional attachments checked on their real bytes
- Anti-spam: the official ALTCHA library and widget (vendored), honeypot, minimum fill time, per-client and global rate limits
- Strict CSP, CSRF without sessions, no raw IP stored, only technical cookies
- English, Italian, Spanish, French and German; languages discovered from `app/lang/`
- Licensed under MIT; maintained by Salvatore Noschese
